# Out at Slack

*Nessa wants you in a pilot boat with her at slack water. Clear 50 Saltgulls from the Wrack Ledges first, then meet her at the lowest quay steps.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Goa Harbour](../towns/goa_harbour_quests.md) |
| Category | Side |
| Given by | [Nessa](../npcs/warden_nessa.md) |
| Level | 46 |
| After | [Under the Saltface](../quests/nessa_under_the_saltface.md) |

## Objectives

1. Defeat 50 [Saltgull](../monsters/saltgull.md) in [The Wrack Ledges](../maps/wrack_ledges.md)
2. Reach the lowest quay steps in [Goa Harbour](../maps/goa_harbour.md)

## Rewards

- 30,000 EXP
- 1,840 mesos
- [Elixir](../items/elixir.md) x5
- [Gap Inn Stew](../items/gap_inn_stew.md) x5
- +40 standing with Goa Harbour
- +200 standing with [Nessa](../npcs/warden_nessa.md)
